question: Estimate monthly TV sales in Bengaluru.
idealClarificationQuestions: All TVs: smart + non-smart, all screen sizes? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × annual TV purchase rate × monthly distribution.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian TV market FY26: ~150 lakh units/year (1.5 crore).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Brand mix: Xiaomi/Mi ~15%, Samsung ~14%, LG ~12%, OnePlus/Realme/Vu ~20%, Sony ~9%, others 30%.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: Xiaomi/Mi ~15%, Samsung ~14%, LG ~12%, OnePlus/Realme/Vu ~20%, Sony ~9%, others 30%.

calculationFlow: Indian TV market FY26: ~150 lakh units/year (1.5 crore).
Bengaluru's share of national TV demand (high purchasing power, large young workforce): ~3-4% of national = ~5 lakh units/year.
